result.description: Coda (now Superhuman Docs) is a collaborative doc/table/app workspace combining docs, spreadsheets and automations.
result.auth_detail: Per-user API token sent as Authorization: Bearer. No third-party OAuth found in readable docs (unconfirmed, not ruled out). Each end user can generate own token.
result.access_detail: API free in free and paid workspaces. Per-user tokens, no app review/publishing found. Caveat: actions follow token owner's workspace role (e.g. Doc Maker needed to create docs). Plans page content not readable; pricing not verified beyond the docs statement.
result.api_notes: REST v1 at https://coda.io/apis/v1: docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, controls, permissions, analytics. Rate limits: read 100/6s, write 10/6s, doc content write 5/10s, list docs 4/6s. Docs moved to docs.superhuman.com (coda.io 307-redirects). Breadth inferred from community MCP's ~54 tools plus docs; endpoint list not fully read (page truncated).

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.
We do not currently support client libraries apart from Google Apps Script.
If you plan to integrate Superhuman Docs with an AI tool, you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server
